title: Remediate stale prefix-index leak and cross-tenant cache poisoning
creator: Ravi Patel
description:
Summary:
During a production capacity spike on 2026-02-27 we observed an increase in per-node memory usage and cross-tenant inference errors. Root cause analysis shows a regression in the prefix-index reconciliation path that allowed stale tombstones and stale prefix metadata to remain referenced in the shared prefix cache. Under load this produced: (1) unbounded reference retention (a reference-counting leak) that prevented expected eviction, (2) hash-collision edge cases where stale metadata was served to the wrong tenant (cache poisoning), and (3) an eviction storm on downstream restarts when the cache attempted bulk recovery, amplifying load and causing short-lived capacity exhaustion.

Timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-27 03:10 UTC: First SLO alerts (token latency P95 increase).
- 2026-02-27 03:18 UTC: Error rates for a subset of customers increased; SRE invoked mitigation toggle to disable shared prefix sharing.
- 2026-02-27 04:05 UTC: Emergency restarts for a handful of pods to free leaked memory.
- 2026-02-28 to 2026-03-02: RCA working sessions; reproducer added to integration tests.

Root cause (technical):
- A change in commit abc1234 (runtime/kv: optimize prefix reconciliation) introduced a fast-path that bypassed tombstone application when reconciliation observed a sequence gap. The optimization assumed monotonic sequence numbers across the cache and did not account for tenant-scoped rehashing introduced earlier. As a result, some tombstones were not applied to the shared prefix index, leaving stale entries that continued to hold references to underlying KV values. Reference-count decrement logic also had a race when eviction and reconcilers ran concurrently, allowing counts to never reach zero.

Impact:
- Memory leak on affected nodes; peak per-node RSS increased ~32% for ~4 hours on affected fleet during the spike.
- Cross-tenant data mixing limited to prefix metadata (no user prompt content observed).
- Several customers reported degradations (latency and transient 5xx), one customer escalated (enterprise contract).

Mitigations completed during incident: 
- Emergency toggle "runtime.shared_prefix_sharing=false" rolled out to all regions to prevent cross-tenant sharing (short-term containment).
- Increased eviction aggressiveness on affected node pool and forced rolling restarts to reclaim memory.
- Hotfix PR opened to re-enable proper tombstone application in the reconciliation fast-path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7890

Long-term remediation plan (this ticket covers coordination and tracking):
- Correct reference counting race and add deterministic destructor tests (owner: Maya Chen, ETA: 2026-03-15).
- Replace fast-path with safe fast-path that validates tenant-scoped hashes before bypassing tombstone apply (owner: Lucas Rivera, ETA: 2026-03-22).
- Add unit + integration tests that simulate high-concurrency reconciliation + eviction workloads (owner: Ravi Patel, ETA: 2026-03-18).
- Add a canary rollout for shared_prefix_sharing true/false with per-tenant isolation verification (owner: SRE oncall, ETA: 2026-04-01).
- Update runbooks and postmortem docs with explicit detection queries and playbook (owner: SRE Runbook Squad, ETA: 2026-03-12).
- Add telemetry: a new metric "prefix_cache.stale_ref_count" and an alert when it grows > 1000 per node for 5 minutes (owner: Observability team, ETA: 2026-03-10).
- Security review for cross-tenant exposure and formal customer notification template (owner: Security PM, ETA: 2026-03-09).

Acceptance criteria for this ticket:
- PRs merged that fix tombstone application and refcount races and pass CI.
- New integration tests committed and running in CI that reproduce previously observed memory growth under synthetic load.
- Telemetry and alerting in place and validated in staging.
- Runbook updated with step-by-step containment and recovery steps and tested via tabletop exercise.
- Customer notification drafted and approved by legal & security for affected customers.

Artifacts and links:
- Incident timeline & raw logs: https://internal.redwood.com/incidents/2026-02-27-prefix-cache
- RCA document: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Prefix+Index+Reconciliation+RCA
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7890
- Integration reproducer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/tree/main/test/integration/prefix_repro
